parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Pitt Meadows · Bonson Road and Blakely Road
Mid Meadows is an MLS® sub-area name. The City of Pitt Meadows doesn’t publish a boundary for it.

Fixed points from City and school addresses: Edith McDermott Elementary is at 12178 Bonson Road, Davie Jones Elementary is at 12030 Blakely Road, and Pitt Meadows Athletic Park and Pitt Meadows Arena are on Bonson Road.
My working description, from those addresses only and not an official boundary: the Bonson Road area south of the CP rail line and Hammond Road. My
South Meadows guide
covers the south end of Bonson Road.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 18, 2026. I have worked in Lower Mainland real estate since 2015. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Pitt Meadows and School District 42.
General information only.

Quick facts
Gathered from official sources.
Transit

Route 722 (Bonson / Meadowtown) stops at Pitt Meadows Station and loops along Harris Road, Ford Road, 190A Street and Hammond Road, plus Blakely Road, 116B Avenue and Bonson Road, getting to Fraser Way and the Barnston View roundabout.
Route 719 (Fraser Way / Meadowtown) picks up where the 722 leaves off, using Fraser Way and Bonson Road, then Wildwood and Hammond Road, on its way to Maple Meadows Station in Maple Ridge.

Route 701 connects Haney Place with Coquitlam Central Station. Within Pitt Meadows its stop is Pitt Meadows Station (Bay 3), and on the way to Coquitlam it follows Hammond Road, Harris Road and Lougheed Highway.

blocks.text: Planning and flood notes for Mid Meadows

parts.t: Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.

“I See Pitt Meadows 2040” is the name of the Official Community Plan the City adopted on September 27, 2022. Goal 2 describes a community in which farmland is protected for food production and agriculture is the main land use. Goal 5 calls for a compact, walkable community offering a range of housing options.
I found no neighbourhood or area plan specific to the Bonson Road area on the City pages I read.

The Diking District for Pitt Meadows / Maple Ridge covers 3,546 hectares, 3,136 of them in Pitt Meadows. The City says drainage Area 3 (Kennedy, including McKechnie) is its urban development area, with ditches, culverts and storm sewers serving it, while low-lying catchments drain through floodboxes and pump stations to the Pitt, Alouette and Fraser Rivers.
According to the City, 60 km of dikes protect it almost entirely, keeping river flooding away from its low-lying areas and key infrastructure.
The City says Pitt Meadows is at risk of flooding annually in May and June.
Per the City’s Financial Plan 2026–2030, more than 85% of the land base in Pitt Meadows sits inside the floodplains of the Alouette, Pitt and Fraser rivers.
In the Financial Plan 2026–2030, the City notes that agriculture is still the main land use in Pitt Meadows, and 78% of the land there is inside the Agricultural Land Reserve.
I found no City statement on how much ALR land is inside the Bonson Road urban area.

Pitt Meadows has a single West Coast Express station, according to the City, and it is Pitt Meadows Station in the urban core. Harris Road is where it sits, and that falls in my Central Meadows guide area and not in Mid Meadows.
Route 595 (Langley Centre / Maple Meadows Station) stays out of Pitt Meadows, connecting Maple Meadows Station in Maple Ridge with Langley Centre.
For a specific lot, send me the address and I’ll look up the zone and the plan designation.

parts.t: Check the flood and drainage rules for the lot.
Find out from the City how the dikes, drainage and floodplain mapping apply to the exact address, particularly where a basement or an addition is involved.
Check what the plan allows nearby.
Check with the City on what the Official Community Plan designations permit on the neighbouring lots, since new buildings can change a street.
Confirm the school catchment.
Ask SD42 for the exact address.
For a strata home, read the documents.
The depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees, plus any special levies.
Get a full home inspection.
Check the roof, drainage, furnace, plumbing and wiring.
Check the ALR on any larger lot.
Look up the address on the Agricultural Land Commission map before you plan anything on farmland.
Where is Mid Meadows?
Mid Meadows is an MLS® sub-area name. The City of Pitt Meadows doesn’t publish a boundary for it.
The City’s and the Province’s lists give fixed locations for Davie Jones Elementary (12030 Blakely Road), Pitt Meadows Athletic Park (Bonson Road) and Edith McDermott Elementary (12178 Bonson Road).
How do I get around from Mid Meadows?

The 722 (Bonson / Meadowtown) is a loop route. It travels Harris Road, Ford Road and 190A Street, then Hammond Road, then Blakely Road, 116B Avenue and Bonson Road, ending up at Fraser Way and the Barnston View roundabout, and Pitt Meadows Station is one of the stops.
Route 719 (Fraser Way / Meadowtown) carries on from the 722, following Fraser Way and Bonson Road as well as Wildwood and Hammond Road, then arrives at Maple Meadows Station in Maple Ridge.

Between Haney Place and Coquitlam Central Station, route 701 makes a stop at Pitt Meadows Station (Bay 3) in Pitt Meadows. Travelling toward Coquitlam, it uses Hammond Road, then Harris Road, then Lougheed Highway.
Routes 722, 719 and 701 have timetables effective September 7, 2026. I read TransLink’s timetable PDFs on October 18, 2026, so check the current timetable.

The City says Pitt Meadows’ one West Coast Express station is Pitt Meadows Station, located in the urban core. Harris Road, which the station is on, belongs to my Central Meadows guide area rather than Mid Meadows.
Which schools are near Mid Meadows?
At 12178 Bonson Road is Edith McDermott Elementary (Kindergarten to 7), while Davie Jones Elementary (Kindergarten to 7) is located at 12030 Blakely Road.
According to the City, Somerset Park and the school field are at 12778 Bonson Road, whereas SD42 and the Province put the school at 12178 Bonson Road.

Of the public secondary schools on the Province’s SD42 list, only Pitt Meadows Secondary is in Pitt Meadows. It serves Grades 8 to 12 at 19438 116B Avenue, and the Province expects a new school on the same property to open for students by fall 2029.
Catchments are set by address, so confirm a specific address with
School District 42 (SD42)
What parks and recreation are there?
On Bonson Road you will find Pitt Meadows Athletic Park at 11431, Pitt Meadows Arena at 11435 and Somerset Park at 12778, while North Bonson Park can be found on Blakely Road, in the 121 block.
Inside the civic centre, close to City Hall and the Family Recreation Centre, is the Pitt Meadows Public Library, at 200 – 12099 Harris Road. It is the only branch I could find in Pitt Meadows.
What plan covers Mid Meadows?

Adopted on September 27, 2022, the City’s Official Community Plan is called “I See Pitt Meadows 2040”. Goal 2 envisions a community where agriculture dominates land use, with farmland kept for growing food, and Goal 5 envisions a walkable, compact one offering a range of housing options.
I found no neighbourhood plan specific to the Bonson Road area.
Is Mid Meadows in a floodplain?

Of the 3,546 hectares in the Pitt Meadows / Maple Ridge Diking District, 3,136 are in Pitt Meadows. The City describes drainage Area 3 (Kennedy, including McKechnie) as the urban development area, which relies on ditches, culverts and storm sewers. It adds that low-lying catchments empty into the Fraser, Alouette and Pitt Rivers by way of floodboxes and pump stations.
The City says Pitt Meadows is at risk of flooding annually in May and June.
Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.
What are the homes and lots like?
I found no official description of home types for the Bonson Road area.

The median lot size for detached houses that sold over the period running July 1 to October 8, 2026 comes to 6,006 sq ft, using 5 sales that have a recorded lot size. The numbers come from MLS sales data and are not official.
That is only 5 sales.
